sentence: This project builds ultrathin 2D material quantum holograms that generate and manipulate entangled photon pairs.
This project studies how insecticides affect the survival and growth of the upside-down jellyfish and its bacterial community.
This project builds small autonomous robots and machine learning tools that monitor plants individually and treat them with minimum amount of chemicals.
This project develops strategies to mitigate bias in computer vision systems that make automated decisions based on visual information.
This project tests whether a gene on a tiny fragment chromosome rearranges the genome in maize.
This project builds computer methods that use deep neural networks to analyze strategic interactions where participants are uncertain about the preferences of others.
This project studies how light flows in patterned silicon films and builds miniaturized photodetectors that use the effect.
This project builds computer tools that estimate RNA velocity and detect DNA methylation from Nanopore long-read sequencing data.
This project builds a program that helps faculty discoveries reach real-world deployment in areas such as energy systems and cybersecurity.
This project studies how bacteria communities affect duckweed resilience to multiple stress combinations, such as high temperature and low nutrient levels.
This project studies how magnetic nanomaterials behave in a magnetic field that oscillates back and forth in time.
This project uses theory to design Van der Waals materials that could be topological superconductors.
This project studies systems of quadratic equations over finite fields to build cryptography that is resistant to quantum computing.
